$schema.description: A JSON Schema reference for editors; mabo-ctl ignores it.

command.description: Run this argv; exit 0 passes. Exactly one of command/tcp.

name.description: Check name, shown in preflight output.

tcp.description: Dial host:port; connecting passes. Exactly one of command/tcp.

ready_timeout.description: How long a readiness probe polls before a service is slow, then degraded. Default 30s. Accepts "10s", "1m30s", "500ms" or a bare number of seconds.

autostart.description: false opts out of a bare `mabo-ctl start` only; naming the service always starts it. Default true.

cmd.description: The argv to run — never a shell string. cmd[0] is resolved through runtime:.

color.description: Terminal colour for this service's label: a name (green, blue, bright-cyan, …), a 0-255 palette number, or #rrggbb.

depends_on.description: Services that start first. Orders STARTS only — stop never expands dependencies.

dir.description: Working directory relative to this file; must exist and stay inside the repo root. Defaults to the repo root.

additionalProperties.description: Environment values are scalars; unquoted numbers and booleans are read as strings.

env.description: Inline environment. Values are templates. Overrides env_file key by key.

env_file.description: KEY=VALUE file anchored at the repo root; inline env: overrides it. Validated at load, re-read at every resolve.

health.description: Readiness URL; {{.Port}} and {{.Port "name"}} templates allowed. Empty = no readiness probe.

name.description: Required. Must match the pattern: the name composes .dev/logs/<name>.log and .dev/pids/<name>.pid, so / or .. would write outside .dev/.

port.description: 0 (the default) = no port and no port guard.

ready_timeout.description: This service's own readiness window, overriding the global. Leave out to inherit. Accepts "10s", "1m30s", "500ms" or a bare number of seconds.

runtime.description: "", "system", "conda:<env>" or "node:<version>". Resolves cmd[0] to an absolute interpreter path; never falls back to ambient PATH.

service.description: Service whose dir and environment to reuse; empty means the repo root and the caller's environment.

stop_grace.description: How long Stop waits after SIGTERM before SIGKILL. Default 10s. Accepts "10s", "1m30s", "500ms" or a bare number of seconds.
